dedupe_keys.name: horaires et arrets des transport publics netex

description: Horaires et arrêts des transport publics (NeTEx) is a dataset listed in The Luxembourg Data Platform, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Administration des transports publics . Public transport stops and bus and train timetables throughout Luxembourg. Includes AVL, CFL, LUXTRAM, RGTR and TICE lines. The data are available in the open NeTEx format (. Coverage: Administration des transports publics . The portal shows the English title as "Timetables and stops for public transport (NeTEx)" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Administration des transports publics . Its keywords include mobilite, bus, public-transport, transport-public, its, public-sector. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://data.europa.eu/88u/.well-known/genid/81d5ed4e02f41ecc6cbd4ee682dbd152). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-la-plateforme-de-donnees-luxembourgeoise.
